thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — high error-rate observed for model v2b during canary traffic window. Alerts: 5xx spike, latency p95 > 2s. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary
Sam: I’m looking. Canary got 10% of traffic starting 10:12 UTC, we started seeing errors ~10:18.
Jordan: Customer impact = a few UX failures on autocomplete; some requests returned malformed JSON. Not full outage but visible. Ticket coming in from Acme Corp support.
Maya: joining — can you dump canary vs prod diffs?
Devin: pulling logs now. attaching first pass diffs.
Devin: ```
--- canary_v2b_latency.log (10:15-10:30)
p95=2200ms p50=95ms error_rate=3.8%
--- prod_v2a_latency.log (10:15-10:30)
p95=420ms p50=88ms error_rate=0.2%
```
Lia: those error lines look like tokenizer mismatch / invalid token sequences. sharing sample stack: ```
ERROR: KV cache mismatch at step 14
  at encoder/tokenize (model/runtime.go:412)
  at runtime/generator.go:219
Caused by: unknown token id 65535
```
Sam: hmm unknown token id — that suggests a model build/byte-serialization issue or a tokenizer change between v2a -> v2b. Did the deployment include tokenizer updates?
Jordan: Release notes for v2b show "tokenizer fix" and changed vocab table — build id 2026.04.11-b. But we had ensured tokenizer compat layer was enabled.
Maya: checking rollout config. ```yaml
rollout: canary
canary_percentage: 10
model_versions: v2b -> v2a fallback enabled
pinning: false
```
Devin: fallback was enabled but fallback path errored too (stack traces show fallback attempted then failed on deserialization).
oncall-sre: joining handoff — oncall SRE here. If tokenization is the root cause, rolling back canary seems safest. Confirmed customer impact is low but growing.
Sam: Hypothesis list: 1) v2b introduced incompatible tokenizer/vocab; 2) runtime kernel selection picks a different tokenizer path under certain seq lengths; 3) packaging corruption in canary bundle.
Maya: Can we reproduce locally? I’ll run an inference with v2b container and the failing prompt.
Devin: shared sample prompt that hit error: `{"input":"Where is the nearest gas station?"}`
Devin: local run shows same error. Reproducible.
Sam: Ok that moves root cause probability to tokenizer mismatch / packaging. Action options: A) Immediate rollback of canary to v2a; B) Pin traffic off v2b and continue investigation; C) Patch build and re-run canary. We need a decision within 10 min.
Jordan: recommend rollback to v2a for safety. We can re-run canary after fixing tokenizer.
Lia: Agree. Also want to capture artifacts — bundle the failing binary and tokenizer mapping for the repo. Using `sha256sum` on the model artifact now.
Devin: sha256s: v2a-model.tar.gz -> `f7a1...9d`, v2b-model.tar.gz -> `c3b2...ef`. Uploading to incident storage. https://redwood.internal/incidents/1842203333/artifacts
Sam: who will execute rollback? oncall-sre: can you run the rollback job?
oncall-sre: I can trigger the rollback. Running `redwoodctl rollout abort --deployment model-api --target-version v2a --scope canary` now.
oncall-sre: ```
INFO rollback: initiating canary rollback
INFO api: routing canary traffic -> v2a
```
oncall-sre: done, traffic shifted back to v2a at 10:26 UTC. Monitoring.
Maya: confirm errors dropped?
Devin: post-rollback metrics (10:26-10:35): p95=430ms p50=90ms error_rate=0.15% — looks back to normal.
Jordan: Notifying customer success and logging mitigation in the incident tracker. I'll update Support ticket.
Sam: Good. Next: RCA coordination. We need a coherent timeline and artifacts for postmortem. I'll start a timeline and hypothesis table here — please append.
Sam: Timeline (short):
- 10:12 UTC — Canary rollout v2b (10% traffic)
- 10:18 UTC — First spike in 5xx from canary (alerts start)
- 10:20 UTC — Incident page created, oncall paged
- 10:22 UTC — Logs show tokenizer unknown token errors
- 10:24 UTC — Local reproduction confirmed by Devin
- 10:26 UTC — Rollback to v2a completed
- 10:28 UTC — Metrics back within SLO
Maya: Hypotheses (append):
- H1 (high): v2b tokenizer uses non-backwards-compatible vocab mapping — leads to unknown token ids on inference path
- H2 (med): Packaging process stripped/rewrote tokenizer mapping due to pathing issue in build pipeline
- H3 (low): Runtime kernel path inconsistent for some sequence lengths causing mis-indexing of vocab ids
Devin: Artifacts captured: logs, failing request IDs, model sha256s, container image ids, tokenizer files. All uploaded to incident storage.
Lia: I'll open an internal PR to add a compatibility check in the CI that verifies token id ranges and tokenizer serialization before model push. Drafting now: https://redwood.internal/ci/pulls/4321
Jordan: For the RCA doc we should include canary diff snippet: ```
canary-compare --metric error_rate --from v2a --to v2b --window 10m
-> error_rate delta +3.6% (p<0.01), p95 latency +1700ms
canary-logs grep 'unknown token' | wc -l -> 42 unique request ids
```
Sam: Ownership: Maya + Devin to root-cause the tokenizer mismatch and produce a patch; Lia to add CI guard; Jordan to update customer comms; Sam to draft postmortem and runbook updates.
Maya: estimated time to root cause and fix? I'll need a day to find exact tokenizer diff and produce a rebuild, could be quicker if it's a packaging bug.
Devin: note: v2b build id metadata shows `tokenizer_hash=ab12` which does not match repo `tokenizer_hash=ab13` — looks like wrong artifact used during build.
Sam: That points toward packaging mismatch (H2). Add to hypothesis.
Jordan: any blockers to marking incident resolved? We should keep monitoring for 2h and then close if stable.
oncall-sre: Monitoring set for 2h. I'll set a follow-up alert if error_rate > 0.5% for canary route.
Sam: Great. Final asks before we close this thread: attach the artifact links and failing request ids in the RCA doc, and include the rollback command we ran.
Devin: adding artifacts list now in the incident tracker.
Lia: PR created for CI guard.
Maya: I'll start the rebuild and do a local regression run; will share diff and exact tokenizer-vocab mismatch in the RCA draft.
Sam: Thanks everyone. Marking mitigation complete — moving to investigation state. :thumbsup: 
Jordan: +1 :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident status changed -> mitigated (canary rolled back).
Sam: Closing the operational thread here, will continue RCA coordination in the postmortem doc. Please ping if you find anything new.
